The '''Lair of the Ghost''' was a cave located in the [[Malignant Bog]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] nest, it was named for the monstrous [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] that made its home in the cave's depths&mdash;[[Akure]], the Ghost in the Darkness.
